name: DachaBo! Digi-Pet Sim!
source:
~ A cute digital friend with a special interest in YOU! ~

Manufactured by SayTell Toys in 1996, DachaBo is [̶C̶O̶N̶S̶U̶M̶E̶R̶S̶ ̶S̶H̶O̶U̶L̶D̶ ̶C̶E̶A̶S̶E̶ ̶U̶S̶I̶N̶G̶ ̶T̶H̶I̶S̶ ̶T̶O̶Y̶ ̶A̶N̶D̶ ̶C̶O̶N̶T̶A̶C̶T̶ ̶S̶A̶Y̶T̶E̶L̶L̶ ̶T̶O̶Y̶S̶ ̶F̶O̶R̶ ̶A̶ ̶F̶U̶L̶L̶ ̶R̶E̶F̶U̶N̶D̶ ̶O̶R̶ ̶D̶I̶S̶P̶O̶S̶E̶ ̶O̶F̶ ̶T̶H̶I̶S̶ ̶P̶R̶O̶D̶U̶C̶T̶ ̶I̶M̶M̶E̶D̶I̶A̶T̶E̶L̶Y̶]̶. Meet Bo! Your new best friend forever and ever! Never was there a pet who could love you more!

[From [url=https://jambeebot.itch.io/dachabo-digi-pet]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
～一位可爱的电子伙伴，对你有着特别的兴趣！～

DachaBo由SayTell玩具公司于1996年制造，是[消̶费̶者̶应̶停̶止̶使̶用̶此̶玩̶具̶，̶联̶系̶S̶a̶y̶T̶e̶l̶l̶玩̶具̶公̶司̶获̶得̶全̶额̶退̶款̶，̶或̶立̶即̶丢̶弃̶本̶产̶品̶]̶。认识一下Bo吧！你全新的、永永远远的好朋友！再也不会有哪只宠物，比他更爱你了！

[摘自[url=https://jambeebot.itch.io/dachabo-digi-pet]Itch.io[/url]]
